    'Vermont': 8471,
    'Virginia': 162666,
    'Washington': 209293,
    'West Virginia': 13475,
    'Wisconsin': 117667,
    'Wyoming': 7638
}

# Extract values and sort in ascending order
values = sorted(data.values())
print(f"Number of states: {len(values)}")
print(f"Sorted values: {values}")

# Hill estimator with k = 7
# Sort in descending order for Hill estimator (largest values first)
values_desc = sorted(values, reverse=True)
print(f"Values (descending): {values_desc}")

k = 7
# X_{(n-k+1)} is the kth largest value (index k-1 in 0-indexed)
# X_{(n-i+1)} are the top k values
# For Hill: sum_{i=1 to k} log(X_{(n-i+1)} / X_{(n-k)})

x_n_k = values_desc[k-1]  # X_{(n-k+1)} - the kth largest value
print(f"X(n-k+1) = X({len(values)}-{k}+1) = X({len(values)-k+1}) = {x_n_k}")

# Calculate the sum of logs
sum_logs = 0
for i in range(k):
    x_n_i_plus_1 = values_desc[i]  # X_{(n-i+1)} - the (i+1)th largest
    log_ratio = math.log(x_n_i_plus_1 / x_n_k)
    print(f"i={i+1}: X(n-{i+1}+1) = X({len(values)-i}) = {x_n_i_plus_1}, log({x_n_i_plus_1}/{x_n_k}) = {log_ratio}")
    sum_logs += log_ratio

hill_estimator = sum_logs / k
print(f"\nHill estimator (Pareto tail exponent): {hill_estimator}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(hill_estimator, 3)}")

# Unemployment insurance taxes data for all 50 US states in 2020 (in thousands of dollars)
data = {
    'Alabama': 64332,

    'Texas': 536530,
    'Utah': 60537,
    'Vermont': 8471,
    'Virginia': 162666,
    'Washington': 209293,
    'West Virginia': 13475,
    'Wisconsin': 117667,
    'Wyoming': 7638
}

# Extract values and sort in descending order (largest to smallest)
values_desc = sorted(data.values(), reverse=True)
print(f"Top 10 values: {values_desc[:10]}")

# Hill estimator with k = 7
k = 7
# Using the formula: ξ = (1/k) * sum_{i=1 to k} log(X_i / X_k)
# where X_1 >= X_2 >= ... >= X_n are the order statistics in descending order

X_k = values_desc[k-1]  # The 7th largest value
print(f"X_k (7th largest): {X_k}")

sum_logs = 0
for i in range(k):
    X_i = values_desc[i]  # i-th largest value (0-indexed)
    log_ratio = math.log(X_i / X_k)
    print(f"i={i+1}: X_{i+1} = {X_i}, log({X_i}/{X_k}) = {log_ratio}")
    sum_logs += log_ratio

hill = sum_logs / k
print(f"\nHill estimator: {hill}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(hill, 3)}")
